svg.title: Billing-cycle timing: rules and evidence
svg.desc: Official guide reviewed October 20, 2026: manual renewal with payment takes effect immediately; auto-renewal period change applies at the next renewal. Account test not verified. October 13 registration cart Total changed from $40.59 to $36.59 with HADOMAINS.
